FIELD RECORD

A record of our visits
to mining locations.

Site visits are where the geological, processing and occupational health work actually happens. This page gathers the photography from those visits, grouped by location, so each set can be opened and viewed as a complete collection.

Photography from these visits has not been supplied yet. Every frame below is a reserved slot, and no image on this page is presented as a photograph of a Global Mino site. When the team provides the files together with their locations, dates and captions, they replace the placeholders and each collection opens with the real photographs.

VISIT 01 / SUDAN

Sudan

Global Mino’s work in Sudan centres on gold mining and mineral opportunity assessment.
